review: en, sl, it, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

description.en: Granny Maggie bakes every morning and teaches anyone who stays: the recipe and its ingredients, weighing, mixing and stirring, the rolling pin and the pastry, the gravy for Sunday lunch, and how not to burn it.
description.sl: Babica Maggie peče vsako jutro in uči vsakogar, ki ostane: recept in sestavine, tehtanje, mešanje in mešanje z žlico, valjar in testo za pito, omaka za nedeljsko kosilo in kako je ne zažgati.
description.it: Nonna Maggie cuoce ogni mattina e insegna a chiunque resti: la ricetta e gli ingredienti, pesare, mescolare e girare, il mattarello e la pasta frolla, il sugo dell'arrosto della domenica e come non bruciarlo.
description.de: Oma Maggie backt jeden Morgen und bringt es jedem bei, der bleibt: das Rezept und die Zutaten, abwiegen, mischen und umrühren, das Nudelholz und den Mürbteig, die Bratensoße zum Sonntagsessen und wie man nichts anbrennen lässt.

words.example_en: This recipe for gingerbread is a hundred years old.
words.example_sl: Ta recept za medenjake je star sto let.
words.example_it: Questa ricetta del pan di zenzero ha cent'anni.
words.example_de: Dieses Lebkuchenrezept ist hundert Jahre alt.
words.note: Say recipe in three parts: RES-i-pee. A false friend: a prescription is for medicine.
words.note_sl: Recipe ima tri zloge: RES-i-pi. Lažni prijatelj: zdravniški recept je prescription.
words.note_it: Recipe ha tre sillabe: RES-i-pi. La ricetta del medico è prescription.
words.note_de: Recipe hat drei Silben: RES-i-pi. Ein ärztliches Rezept ist prescription.

words.example_en: You only need four ingredients: flour, butter, sugar and eggs.
words.example_sl: Potrebuješ le štiri sestavine: moko, maslo, sladkor in jajca.
words.example_it: Servono solo quattro ingredienti: farina, burro, zucchero e uova.
words.example_de: Du brauchst nur vier Zutaten: Mehl, Butter, Zucker und Eier.

words.example_en: Maggie bakes bread twice a week.
words.example_sl: Maggie peče kruh dvakrat na teden.
words.example_it: Maggie fa il pane al forno due volte alla settimana.
words.example_de: Maggie backt zweimal die Woche Brot.

words.example_en: Boil the potatoes for twenty minutes.
words.example_sl: Krompir kuhaj dvajset minut.
words.example_it: Fai bollire le patate per venti minuti.
words.example_de: Koch die Kartoffeln zwanzig Minuten.

words.example_en: Jack fries his eggs in butter.
words.example_sl: Jack cvre jajca na maslu.
words.example_it: Jack frigge le uova nel burro.
words.example_de: Jack brät seine Eier in Butter.

words.example_en: On Sundays Maggie roasts a leg of lamb.
words.example_sl: Ob nedeljah Maggie speče jagnječje stegno.
words.example_it: La domenica Maggie arrostisce un cosciotto d'agnello.
words.example_de: Sonntags brät Maggie eine Lammkeule im Ofen.
words.note: Roast is meat or vegetables in the oven; bake is bread and cakes. A Sunday roast is the big Sunday lunch.
words.note_sl: Roast je meso ali zelenjava v pečici; bake kruh in pecivo. Sunday roast je velika nedeljska pečenka.
words.note_it: Roast è carne o verdure al forno; bake pane e dolci. Il Sunday roast è il grande pranzo della domenica.
words.note_de: Roast ist Fleisch oder Gemüse im Ofen; bake Brot und Kuchen. Sunday roast ist der große Sonntagsbraten.

words.example_en: Keep stirring, or the porridge will stick to the pan.
words.example_sl: Kar naprej mešaj, sicer se bo kaša prijela posode.
words.example_it: Continua a rimestare, o il porridge si attacca alla pentola.
words.example_de: Rühr weiter um, sonst brennt der Porridge an.

words.example_en: Mix the flour and the butter with your fingers.
words.example_sl: Moko in maslo zmešaj s prsti.
words.example_it: Mescola la farina e il burro con le dita.
words.example_de: Vermisch das Mehl und die Butter mit den Fingern.

words.example_en: Chop the onions small for the tatie pot.
words.example_sl: Za tatie pot drobno sesekljaj čebulo.
words.example_it: Trita fini le cipolle per il tatie pot.
words.example_de: Hack die Zwiebeln für den Tatie Pot klein.

words.example_en: Can you slice the bread while I make the tea?
words.example_sl: Lahko narežeš kruh, medtem ko pripravim čaj?
words.example_it: Puoi affettare il pane mentre faccio il tè?
words.example_de: Kannst du das Brot schneiden, während ich den Tee mache?
words.note: A slice is one thin piece: a slice of cake.
words.note_sl: A slice je ena rezina: a slice of cake.
words.note_it: A slice è una fetta: a slice of cake.
words.note_de: A slice ist eine Scheibe oder ein Stück: a slice of cake.

words.example_en: Pour the milk in slowly, a little at a time.
words.example_sl: Mleko nalivaj počasi, po malem.
words.example_it: Versa il latte piano, un po' alla volta.
words.example_de: Gieß die Milch langsam ein, nach und nach.

words.example_en: Melt the butter in a small pan.
words.example_sl: Maslo stopi v majhni posodi.
words.example_it: Sciogli il burro in un pentolino.
words.example_de: Schmilz die Butter in einem kleinen Topf.

words.example_en: Taste the soup: does it need more salt?
words.example_sl: Okusi juho: potrebuje več soli?
words.example_it: Assaggia la zuppa: ci vuole più sale?
words.example_de: Probier die Suppe: Braucht sie mehr Salz?
words.note: Taste is also what something is like: It tastes of honey.
words.note_sl: Taste pomeni tudi imeti okus: It tastes of honey.
words.note_it: Taste vuol dire anche sapere di: It tastes of honey.
words.note_de: Taste heißt auch schmecken nach: It tastes of honey.

words.example_en: Weigh out two hundred grams of flour.
words.example_sl: Stehtaj dvesto gramov moke.
words.example_it: Pesa duecento grammi di farina.
words.example_de: Wieg zweihundert Gramm Mehl ab.
words.note: The gh is silent: weigh sounds like "way".
words.note_sl: Gh se ne izgovori: weigh se sliši kot "wej".
words.note_it: Gh non si pronuncia: weigh si dice "uei".
words.note_de: Das gh ist stumm: weigh klingt wie "wäi".

words.example_en: Leave the dough by the fire for an hour to rise.
words.example_sl: Testo pusti uro ob ognju, da vzhaja.
words.example_it: Lascia lievitare l'impasto vicino al fuoco per un'ora.
words.example_de: Lass den Teig eine Stunde am Feuer aufgehen.
words.note: Rise, rose, risen. The sun rises too.
words.note_sl: Rise, rose, risen. Tudi sonce rises (vzhaja).
words.note_it: Rise, rose, risen. Anche il sole rises (sorge).
words.note_de: Rise, rose, risen. Auch die Sonne rises (geht auf).

words.example_en: Oh no, the scones are burnt on the bottom!
words.example_sl: O ne, pogače so spodaj zažgane!
words.example_it: Oh no, gli scones sono bruciati sotto!
words.example_de: Oh nein, die Scones sind unten angebrannt!
words.note: British English says burnt or burned; American mostly burned.
words.note_sl: V britanski angleščini burnt ali burned; v ameriški večinoma burned.
words.note_it: In inglese britannico burnt o burned; in americano soprattutto burned.
words.note_de: Britisch burnt oder burned; amerikanisch meist burned.

words.example_en: Maggie's big mixing bowl was her mother's.
words.example_sl: Maggiejina velika skleda za mešanje je bila od njene mame.
words.example_it: La grande terrina di Maggie era di sua madre.
words.example_de: Maggies große Rührschüssel hat ihrer Mutter gehört.

words.example_en: Stir the jam with a wooden spoon.
words.example_sl: Marmelado mešaj z leseno kuhalnico.
words.example_it: Mescola la marmellata con un cucchiaio di legno.
words.example_de: Rühr die Marmelade mit einem Kochlöffel um.

words.example_en: Put the biscuits on a baking tray, not too close together.
words.example_sl: Piškote daj na pekač, ne preblizu skupaj.
words.example_it: Metti i biscotti su una teglia, non troppo vicini.
words.example_de: Leg die Kekse aufs Backblech, nicht zu eng.

words.example_en: Roll the pastry out thin with the rolling pin.
words.example_sl: Testo z valjarjem tanko razvaljaj.
words.example_it: Stendi la pasta sottile con il mattarello.
words.example_de: Roll den Teig mit dem Nudelholz dünn aus.

words.example_en: Knead the dough until it is smooth.
words.example_sl: Testo gneti, dokler ni gladko.
words.example_it: Lavora l'impasto finché è liscio.
words.example_de: Knete den Teig, bis er glatt ist.
words.note: Say dough "doh": the gh is silent.
words.note_sl: Dough se izgovori "dou": gh se ne sliši.
words.note_it: Dough si pronuncia "dou": il gh non si sente.
words.note_de: Dough spricht man "dou": das gh ist stumm.

words.example_en: Maggie's apple pie has the lightest pastry in the dale.
words.example_sl: Maggiejina jabolčna pita ima najrahlejše testo v dolini.
words.example_it: La torta di mele di Maggie ha la pasta frolla più leggera della valle.
words.example_de: Maggies Apfelkuchen hat den leichtesten Mürbteig im Tal.
words.note: Pastry is also a small cake: a Danish pastry.
words.note_sl: Pastry je tudi slaščica: a Danish pastry.
words.note_it: Pastry è anche un pasticcino: a Danish pastry.
words.note_de: Pastry ist auch ein Gebäckstück: a Danish pastry.

words.example_en: Would you like some mint sauce with your lamb?
words.example_sl: Bi k jagnjetini malo metine omake?
words.example_it: Vuoi un po' di salsa alla menta con l'agnello?
words.example_de: Möchtest du etwas Minzsoße zum Lamm?

words.example_en: Pour plenty of gravy over the Yorkshire puddings.
words.example_sl: Yorkshire puding obilno prelij z omako od pečenke.
words.example_it: Versa tanto sugo d'arrosto sugli Yorkshire pudding.
words.example_de: Gieß reichlich Bratensoße über die Yorkshire Puddings.
